Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'IG_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز المستخدم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IG_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز المنفذ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IG_D_G_S_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'SHIFT_ID,PORT_CD,GRP_ID' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IG_DG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'Grp Id,رمز المنفذ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'معاينيين المجموعة','المجموعات الجمركية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'معاينيين المجموعة','المجموعات الجمركية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'GDT_DG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المجموعة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Grp Dcltn Types','المجموعات الجمركية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Grp Dcltn Types','المجموعات الجمركية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'D_G_S_USR_FK2') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى رومز المستخدم لمساعد رئيس الوردية', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'D_G_S_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى رومز المستخدم لرئيس الوردية', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'D_G_S_DG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الجمرك,تعريف المجموعة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'IW_D_G_S_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'ورديات المجموعه','دوام المعاينيين' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'ورديات المجموعه','المجموعات الجمركية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'ورديات المجموعه','المجموعات الجمركية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'GRP_ID,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'USR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ,رمز المستخدم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'USR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ,رمز المستخدم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('تم إضافة هذا المعاين لنفس المجموعة من قبل، فقط يمكنك إعادة تفعيله', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'USR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ,رمز المستخدم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'GDT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('تكرار في بيانات المجموعة - أعد إدخال نوع بيان آخر مع المجموعة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'D_G_S_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'اسم الوردية,رمز الجمرك,تعريف المجموعة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(
 P_CANVAS_LIST IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* List of displayed canvases */
 ,P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Display the current canvas plus any others in the canvas list */
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255); /* List of displayed canvases */
 canvas_to_raise VARCHAR2(255); /* Canvas to raise to the top */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 ELSE
 P_CANVAS_LIST := replace(P_CANVAS_LIST, P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',');
 IF ( get_view_property(P_BASE_CANVAS, VISIBLE) = 'FALSE') THEN
 canvas_list := P_CANVAS_LIST;
 WHILE (canvas_list IS NOT NULL) LOOP
 canvas_to_raise := substr(canvas_list, 1, instr(canvas_list, ','));
 canvas_list := replace(canvas_list, canvas_to_raise);
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(rtrim(canvas_to_raise, ','));
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CANVAS_LIST || P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 END IF;
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(P_CURRENT_CANVAS);
END;

-- --< 11/06/2011 AHMED A-MONIM

 /*

 /*

 ;

 V_OWNER_SEQ := EDI_GNRL.GET_MAX_SEQ_OWNERS(REC.MSG_ID);
 INSERT

-- --> 11/06/2011 AHMED A-MONIM

 VALUES (REC.MSG_ID,V_OWNER_SEQ,V_NEW_USER_ID,REC.PORT_CD,REC.DOC_TYPE,REC.MSG_TYPE);

FUNCTION CHCK_ROLE_PRIVS2
 RETURN BOOLEAN
IS

 CURSOR C_ROLES
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES SCUR
 WHERE USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UR_ACTIVE = 1

 (SELECT '1'

 AND EXISTS
 (SELECT '1'
 FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID = SCGR.ROLE_ID)
 MINUS

 WHERE UER.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND UER.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD

 FOR C_REC_ROLE IN C_ROLES

 END LOOP;

 THEN

 END IF;

/* CGLT$TAB_BLOCK_MANAGEMENT */
/* Switch tab management code on/off */
DECLARE

 base_canvas VARCHAR2(61);
BEGIN
 CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF( base_canvas IN ( 'CG$PAGE_1' ) ) THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 ELSE
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := FALSE;
 END IF;

 CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT;

 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$NEW_BLOCK;

END;
